messages:
alex: Cutting RC candidate v2.14.0 now. Pinning images sha: inference-service@sha256:abcd1234ef.., api-gateway@sha256:ef011234.. Requesting ops signoff for promo window 2026-03-21 00:00-02:00 UTC. @jen-ops @maria_g
jen-ops: ack. Can we gate promo on these: canary error delta >5% OR p95 latency >600ms. Need release notes link before promo.
maria_g: quick eyeball of CHANGELOG looks good. running full regression (smoke + critical evals) — ETA ~12m.
deploy-bot: Deploy candidate created: rc-2026-03-21-2797654321. Artifacts pinned: inference-service:sha256:abcd1234, api-gateway:sha256:ef011234. Canary route created -> 1% traffic.
alex: plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation at 10%. Rollback triggers: +5% error rate vs baseline OR 20% latency regression. Fallback policy: route to quantized-variant if p95 > 800ms for 3m.
simon: I noticed a DB migration in the branch — is it backwards compatible?
alex: it's an index-only migration (CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY). Will run as post-deploy job with --backfill=false. No schema writes in request path.
maria_g: regression run: `pytest tests/integration/test_inference.py::test_streaming -q` -> all green locally. Uploading run to CI.
jen-ops: rollback playbook (short): 1) pin traffic to previous prod image prod-2026-03-15-2567, 2) run rollback-kvclear job with --preserve-keys false, 3) open #incidents and @oncall. I'll be on call during window.
deploy-bot: Canary at 1% complete. Metrics snapshot -> error_rate 0.12% (baseline 0.10%), p95 latency 480ms (baseline 450ms). No alarms.
alex: good — proceed to 10%.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift initiated: /shift 10 -> will complete in ~60s.
jen-ops: release_notes added: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-rc-v2.14.0-brief (contains changelog, migration notes, rollback steps).
maria_g: small rerank timeout regression surfaced on staging; opened PR (#4321) that bumps timeout and adds retry. Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321
simon: looks fine, lgtm for timeout bump. Monitor evals after merge.
deploy-bot: Traffic at 10%. Metrics: error_rate 0.18%, p95 520ms. No increase in CPU or GPU saturation.
alex: holding at 10% for 15m observation window. If stable, we'll move to 50%.
jen-ops: enabling automatic fallback to quantized variant on latency spike: policy set -> if p95 > 800ms for 3m then route affected traffic to model-quant-v1.
alex: authorize fallback policy. Marking signoff set: alex, jen-ops, maria_g, simon.
maria_g: signoff.
jen-ops: signoff.
simon: signoff.
deploy-bot: Promo to prod scheduled: 2026-03-21T00:30:00Z. Promoted artifact tag: prod-2026-03-21-v2.14.0-shaabcd. Canary cleanup jobs queued.
alex: final note for release notes: "v2.14.0 — minor perf fixes, rerank timeout fix, index-only migration (safe)". Sending watch: @all-hands. :tada:
jen-ops: I'll keep monitoring first 30m post-promo. If anything abnormal, we'll execute rollback procedure. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Closing thread: promo scheduled and artifacts pinned. Logs: /logs/deploy/2797654321 (internal).
